ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central regions) to low-intensity black pixels (peripheral borders).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity contiguous white regions on both lobes framed by a solid low-intensity black perimeter. Three distinct dark vertical linear streaks are visible on the right lobe's interior ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map along the entire trailing edge, characterized by distinct triangular peaks and V-shaped valleys with a pixel depth of approximately 8-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on both lobes, tapering to sharp, acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (approximate diameter 5-8 pixels) situated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, sub-parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) mapped on the high-intensity region of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.
